title: RPEG: Training Reasoning Language Models Scalably and Cost-Effectively
abstract: arXiv:2611.09207v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is now central to training Reasoning Language Models (RLMs), but RLM pipelines are difficult to scale and costly to run because each RL step couples multiple large models, heterogeneous stages, cross-step state, and complex asynchronous dependencies. Existing systems typically optimize only parts of this design space. We address this complexity by jointly optimizing the pipeline structure as well as its execution using a novel data-centric graph intermediate representation called RLM Pipeline Execution Graph (RPEG). RPEG exposes structural choices such as bounded asynchrony and actor-critic sharing together with execution optimizations such as stage fusion, fine-grained scheduling, and multi-dimensional model parallelism. It is coupled with a comprehensive analytical performance model for RLM training, jointly capturing compute, communication, memory, and hierarchical rack-, node-, and GPU-level effects. Acr

translated_title: RPEG：可扩展且高性价比地训练推理语言模型
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）如今是训练推理语言模型（RLM）的核心方法，但由于每个 RL 步骤都耦合了多个大模型、异构阶段、跨步骤状态以及复杂的异步依赖关系，RLM 流水线难以扩展且运行成本高昂。现有系统通常只优化该设计空间的部分环节。我们通过一种新颖的以数据为中心的图中间表示——RLM 流水线执行图（RPEG），对流水线结构及其执行进行联合优化，从而应对这一复杂性。RPEG 揭示了诸如受限异步与 actor-critic 共享等结构性选择，同时结合阶段融合、细粒度调度和多维模型并行等执行优化。它还配套了一个面向 RLM 训练的全面分析性能模型，可联合刻画计算、通信、内存以及机架、节点、GPU 层级的分层效应。
tldr: 提出了一种新颖的以数据为中心的图中间表示 RPEG，通过联合优化 RLM 强化学习训练流水线的结构与执行，并结合综合分析性能模型，实现了推理语言模型训练的可扩展性与高性价比。
en_tdlr: RPEG, a novel data-centric graph intermediate representation that jointly optimizes pipeline structure and execution for RLM reinforcement learning training, coupled with a comprehensive analytical performance model, enables scalable and cost-effective training of Reasoning Language Models.
